# GMPSignal — 40 Enterprise Data, Quantitative Crypto, B2B, KYB, Cyber & Regulatory APIs (Apify & MCP)

> GMPSignal (@gmpsignal) publishes 40 production-grade JSON APIs and Model Context Protocol (MCP) tools on the Apify platform for AI Agents, Quantitative Trading Bots, B2B Sales Enrichment (Clay, n8n, Make), Global KYB/Sanctions Compliance, DevSecOps (CISA KEV + EPSS), Academic R&D, Shopify E-Commerce, and Regulatory Filings (SEC EDGAR, FDA, EU TED).

- **Apify Store Publisher Profile:** https://apify.com/gmpsignal
- **Official Interactive Portal:** https://devburaq.github.io/gmpsignal-portal/
- **Full LLM Technical Reference:** https://devburaq.github.io/gmpsignal-portal/llms-full.txt
- **OpenAPI 3.1.0 Schema (OpenAI Custom GPT Actions — 16 Flagship):** https://devburaq.github.io/gmpsignal-portal/openapi-gpt-actions.json
- **OpenAPI 3.1.0 Schema (Complete 40-Actor Suite):** https://devburaq.github.io/gmpsignal-portal/openapi.json
- **Official Anthropic MCP Registry ID:** `io.github.devburaq/gmpsignal-mcp-server` (`@gmpsignal/mcp-server@1.3.0`)
- **Hosted MCP Server Gateway:** https://mcp.apify.com
- **Pricing Model:** Transparent Pay-Per-Event ($1.00 to $5.00 per 1,000 structured records; no monthly subscription required).

## Quick Connect via Model Context Protocol (Claude Desktop, Cursor, Windsurf)

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "gmpsignal-intelligence-suite": {
      "command": "npx",
      "args": [
        "-y",
        "@apify/actors-mcp-server",
        "--actors",
        "gmpsignal/dex-token-scanner-security-auditor,gmpsignal/crypto-orderbook-arbitrage-scanner,gmpsignal/multichain-wallet-aml-risk-screener,gmpsignal/defi-yield-tvl-stablecoin-monitor,gmpsignal/prediction-markets-polymarket-kalshi-scanner,gmpsignal/b2b-company-techstack-contacts-enricher,gmpsignal/global-sanctions-pep-gleif-kyb-screener,gmpsignal/cyber-cve-kev-epss-vulnerability-scanner,gmpsignal/startup-vc-dealflow-yc-github-radar,gmpsignal/academic-patent-research-citation-intelligence,gmpsignal/shopify-global-store-products-scraper"
      ],
      "env": {
        "APIFY_TOKEN": "<YOUR_APIFY_API_TOKEN>"
      }
    }
  }
}
```

## Flagship Intelligence APIs (Top 16 Global Verticals)

- [DEX Token Scanner & Rugpull Security Auditor](https://apify.com/gmpsignal/dex-token-scanner-security-auditor): Real-time DexScreener + GoPlus smart contract honeypot, mint/freeze authority, buy/sell tax, and liquidity lock auditing across Solana, Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, and BSC ($3.50 / 1k items).
- [Crypto Order Book, Slippage & Funding Arbitrage](https://apify.com/gmpsignal/crypto-orderbook-arbitrage-scanner): Live Level-2 order book depth, $10k/$50k/$100k execution slippage, and cross-exchange arbitrage spread scanner across Binance, Bybit, Kraken, Coinbase, OKX, and KuCoin ($3.00 / 1k items).
- [Multi-Chain Wallet Portfolio & AML Risk Screener](https://apify.com/gmpsignal/multichain-wallet-aml-risk-screener): EVM & Solana wallet balance, recent transaction velocity, mixer/sanctions exposure, and automated AML risk scoring ($4.00 / 1k items).
- [DeFi Yield Farming, Protocol TVL & Stablecoin Monitor](https://apify.com/gmpsignal/defi-yield-tvl-stablecoin-monitor): DeFiLlama APY yield pools, multi-chain protocol TVL momentum, and stablecoin peg health intelligence ($2.50 / 1k items).
- [Polymarket, Kalshi & Manifold Prediction Markets API](https://apify.com/gmpsignal/prediction-markets-polymarket-kalshi-scanner): Real-time implied probabilities, order volume, liquidity, and cross-venue odds comparison across Polymarket, Kalshi, and Manifold ($3.50 / 1k items).
- [B2B Domain Tech Stack, Contacts, DNS & SSL Enricher](https://apify.com/gmpsignal/b2b-company-techstack-contacts-enricher): Extracts decision-maker emails, phone numbers, social links, 38+ tech stack fingerprints, MX/SPF/DMARC security posture, and RDAP registration data from company domains ($4.00 / 1k items).
- [Global Corporate KYB, GLEIF LEI & Sanctions Screen](https://apify.com/gmpsignal/global-sanctions-pep-gleif-kyb-screener): Screens corporate entities and individuals against GLEIF Legal Entity Identifiers (LEI), OFAC/UN/EU sanctions lists, and PEP databases ($4.50 / 1k items).
- [CVE Vulnerability, CISA KEV, EPSS & Exploit Scanner](https://apify.com/gmpsignal/cyber-cve-kev-epss-vulnerability-scanner): Correlates CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV), FIRST.org 30-day EPSS exploitation probabilities, and NVD CVSS v3 scores ($3.00 / 1k items).
- [YC Startups, GitHub Trending & HN DealFlow Radar](https://apify.com/gmpsignal/startup-vc-dealflow-yc-github-radar): Aggregates Y Combinator directory startups, GitHub trending repositories, and Hacker News Show/Launch traction signals for VC deal-flow ($3.50 / 1k items).
- [OpenAlex Scientific Papers, Citations & R&D Monitor](https://apify.com/gmpsignal/academic-patent-research-citation-intelligence): Multi-source scientific literature, citation velocity, DOI metadata, and abstract intelligence across OpenAlex, Semantic Scholar, Crossref, and arXiv ($3.00 / 1k items).
- [Shopify Store Products, Variants & Pricing Scraper](https://apify.com/gmpsignal/shopify-global-store-products-scraper): Extracts complete product catalogs, SKU variants, stock availability, and discount percentages from any global Shopify store ($2.50 / 1k items).
- [SEC EDGAR Filings Scraper - 10-K, 10-Q, 8-K, Form 4](https://apify.com/gmpsignal/sec-edgar-filings): Official US SEC EDGAR corporate filings and insider transactions ($2.00 / 1k items).
- [EU TED Public Procurement & Tenders Scraper](https://apify.com/gmpsignal/eu-ted-tenders-scraper): European Union Tenders Electronic Daily (TED) public procurement notices, CPV codes, and PDF/HTML contract links ($2.00 / 1k items).
- [FDA Warning Letters & GMP Compliance Scraper](https://apify.com/gmpsignal/fda-warning-letters-scraper): US FDA pharmaceutical, medical device, and food GMP inspection warning letters ($2.00 / 1k items).
- [FDA Recalls & Enforcement - Drugs, Devices, Food](https://apify.com/gmpsignal/fda-recalls-enforcement): Official openFDA drug, device, and food recall enforcement actions ($2.00 / 1k items).
- [Earthquake Monitor - USGS, EMSC & AFAD Multi-Network](https://apify.com/gmpsignal/earthquake-monitor-usgs-emsc-afad): Cross-verified global seismic events combining USGS, EMSC, and AFAD feeds ($1.00 / 1k items).
